class.name: inspire_franka_sim/ThreadPairPlugin
class.description: Publishes the threaded M24 nut's axial position and twist angle on /thread_state, clamps the thread while /thread_hold is true, and returns it to its start pose on the bolt on /reset_thread. Needed by inspire_franka_policy_scene.xml, whose nut is not part of the robot and so has no ros2_control state interface; idle in every other scene.
